name: GlobalInsert
caption: When a record is inserted

configuration.description: Table whose inserts start the flow. Stored on the trigger registration at publish; 0 means the flow never fires.

Field filters the inserted record must match: [{ "fieldNo": <integer>, "filter": "<BC filter expression>" }]. Rows with fieldNo 0 are skipped; a second row on the same field overwrites the first. The filter text is applied literally with standard Business Central filter syntax (truncated to 250 characters); placeholders are not resolved. Empty array = every insert fires.

outputs.name: Rec
outputs.when: always; type 'reference' with tableNo = configuration.tableNo when tableNo > 0, otherwise declared as type 'value'

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be set: the config canvas marks Table as required and does not save without it. Not checked at publish: a flow with tableNo 0 or a table that does not exist publishes and never fires.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be > 0; 0 shows as an empty required Table field in the config canvas.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: A filter expression that cannot be applied (bad syntax, unknown field) does not raise an error; the record is treated as not matching and the flow does not start. The user's insert is never blocked.

notes: Fires on every insert of the table in any session (UI, API, background, posting), through Business Central's global database insert event.

Execution is asynchronous: the insert creates a pending execution inside the inserting transaction (it disappears if that transaction rolls back). A recurring Job Queue entry created on publish (every 5 minutes) picks up pending executions and queues one Job Queue entry per execution. Expect up to ~5 minutes latency.
Asynchronous runs commit after every step (no trigger in AutoFlow currently opts into one-transaction runs).
At insert time an auto-increment primary key is not final yet; the engine re-resolves the Rec reference by SystemId when the flow runs, so Rec points at the stored record.

Step-level rule imposed by this trigger: a Confirm dialog step gets a publish warning ('The confirm dialog '%1' runs inside the record change that started the flow. Business Central does not open dialogs there, so when a user triggers the flow it fails at this step. It only works when the flow runs in the background, where the answer under 'Without a user interface' applies.').
Picker filters: Respond to Webhook, Return SubFlow Output, Return PDF, Set report file name, Set document field values and Prevent page close are hidden.
The filter column is a SmartText column in the config canvas, but there are no upstream outputs to reference and the runtime applies the text as a plain filter expression.
